object_description: single-storey organic building with sprawling arms
design_condition: The free organic building is placed in the inner courtyard, creating varied outdoor spaces, but the required passages through the building and a concrete second entrance are missing, while access across the site remains limited.

positive.statement: The radical approach creates very interesting indoor and outdoor spaces that users can use individually.
The unusual design stimulates discussion about the appropriate school building.
The classrooms are pleasant and easy to use despite the supports.
The project is an interesting and independent solution approach.
The project is fascinating as a sophisticated functional and technical solution.

negative.statement: The connections are bulky and not as smooth as expected.
Decentralized access means that students and teachers sometimes have to travel very long distances.
The uniform facade grid may lead to monotony and self-referentiality.
The entrances are not clearly visible from the outside.
The semi-public tavern would severely disrupt the school's fragile operations.
The attic is a leftover space whose school-compatible use is uncertain.
Access for emergency services, deliveries and agricultural equipment is only possible to a limited extent.
The outdoor-space project remains schematic despite its urban-development potential.
The solution approach is also expensive.
